summary: Several people are charged months after a vandalism spree, with more than one agency deciding the charges.
realLife: Months after an autumn run of shattered windows and break-ins, police charged three people with felonies after several agencies worked together and security video helped. The chief said he hoped it brought closure and deterred others. The city next door was still talking to prosecutors.
